AI Adoption Outpaced Your Controls
AI has scaled faster than traditional security can adapt. Employees, applications, and agents create new exposure points that legacy tools don’t see. You need guardrails where AI runs:
Workforce
Secure AI usage across browsers, SaaS, and copilots.
Applications
Protect model inputs and outputs at the application edge.
Agents
Control tool calls, file access, and autonomous runtime behavior.

We secure AI across workforce usage, customer-facing applications, and autonomous agents — with unified visibility and runtime enforcement.

Stop sensitive data from leaving in prompts
Employees are adopting AI faster than policies can keep up. Security teams need visibility and control that works across browsers, SaaS tools, and copilots without breaking productivity or forcing users to change how they work.
Shadow AI discovery
Sensitive paste detection
Data loss prevention
Explore Workforce AI Controls
Prevent prompt attacks & harmful outputs
As teams embed AI into customer-facing and internal applications, risk shifts to prompts, responses, and model behavior. Protection needs to happen inline where inputs and outputs are generated not after the damage is done.
Prompt injection detection
Jailbreak defense
Data exfiltration protection
Explore Application Runtime Protection
Keep agents from taking unsafe actions
Autonomous agents don’t just generate text they act. As agents gain access to tools, files, and systems, security teams need guardrails that govern what agents can do, not just what they can say.
Tool/privilege abuse prevention
Unsafe autonomy blocking
Looping / DoW risk mitigation
